construction.source_description: Russian Web Tables (RWT), described by the dataset repository as tables from Russian Wikipedia.
construction.selection_and_labeling: The 170 semantic labels are weak/header-derived annotations, not human gold labels. The LoReTA labeling notebook says it assumes the first noun in a header reflects the entity and chooses the most similar semantic type using a Russian word-vector model; the export retains label and label_id but drops the original column header. Do not expose label/label_id to independent annotators. Recover the original header from the RWT metadata and use raw RWT table rows for review.
construction.split: Fixed train/test split. Keep all 115,448 test columns sealed and exclude them from training and mapping decisions.
construction.table_id_mapping: Verified against YRL-AIDA/LoReTA at pinned commit f12d7f83a70a065c90eb314a14e35bf177bade22: collect_headers.cpp derives the identifier from Dataset/data/<page_id>/table_<offset>_meta.json; collection code reads the corresponding table CSV. Thus the numeric path component is the Wikipedia page ID and table_N is the within-page table offset. This confirms the ID shape, but not the exact historical page revision.
construction.header_recovery: LoReTA's collect_headers.cpp reads each RWT table's _meta.json and extracts columns[column_id].name. Use the pinned source mapping to restore headers; the flattened CTA CSV does not contain them.

licensing.LoReTA_repository_license: The pinned LoReTA repository includes a MIT LICENSE (Copyright (c) 2025 YRL-AIDA) and the train/test CSV artifacts. Retain its notice for the LoReTA artifact layer; this does not override underlying Russian Wikipedia rights.
licensing.upstream_rights: RWT paper describes corpus/toolkit as open-source and publicly available, but the public dataset repository listing has no separate dataset license identified. The exact license/permission for the RWT corpus, selection, and database rights remains unresolved.
licensing.underlying_source: RWT is extracted from Russian Wikipedia; the RWT paper reports a 2021-09-13 snapshot. Check the exact page/history/discussion for each reused page, applicable license version, and any imported-content attribution notices. Do not assume a uniform license solely from the snapshot date.
licensing.table_id_mapping: Verified from the pinned LoReTA collection code. A page URL can be reconstructed from page_id as https://ru.wikipedia.org/?curid=<page_id>; the exact 2021 revision and page-level notices remain to be audited.
licensing.attribution_requirement: Wikimedia Terms of Use accept a page hyperlink/URL for attribution and require applicable license notices, modification disclosure, and preservation of extra attribution requirements for imported text.
licensing.clearance_blocker: Keep the full 1,441,349-column candidate on rights hold pending (1) a specific RWT corpus/selection/database permission or a documented conclusion that none is required, and (2) source-page historical revision/license and imported-content notice audit. LoReTA MIT does not by itself resolve upstream rights.
licensing.historical_wikipedia_default: RWT paper reports a 2021-09-13 snapshot; Wikimedia's 2014-2023 Terms were then effective and licensed standard contributor text CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported plus GFDL (reuse may follow either/both). This is a baseline only; page-specific imports/notices and exact historical revision remain to audit.
licensing.database_rights: Creative Commons' data guidance says CC 3.0 Unported does not expressly license sui generis database rights where those rights alone are implicated; assess RWT corpus/selection rights separately.

relevance: Large multilingual column-classification candidate that may add Russian headers and examples. DBpedia labels require a reviewed mapping to LABEL_GUIDE.md; unmappable labels must remain unmapped.
handling: Rights hold. Do not download, redistribute, label, or import into materials/pool/batch_*.jsonl yet. The metadata-only preflight can enumerate every train column's page/table ID and reconstructed page URL after the pinned LoReTA files are obtained. Once rights are cleared, reconstruct original headers from RWT metadata, discard/hide LoReTA label and label_id, and produce bounded blank-answer batches with per-page attribution. Keep all 115,448 test columns sealed.
